messages.m0983bba6c642: Automating your real estate agency with Real Estate CRM
messages.mc0dfbbd9d854: Real estate is, above all, a relationship business... relationships with clients. Managing a dozen clients is one thing; managing hundreds or thousands is another.
messages.mc75aaa0cc23d: CRM systems have become one of the most useful tools for organizing client relationships and company databases. No more worrying about whether you remember what you discussed with a client and when, which properties you showed them or how it went. The CRM remembers everything for you, brings up the right information when you need it and finds ideal matches for your clients. You do not even need to be at a computer: you can do everything on a smartphone or tablet, with notifications and reminders arriving through a Telegram bot or SMS.
messages.m976768f470f6: The business owner benefits most: with all the reports at hand, they can see how many viewings and deals each agent has completed and how much they have earned for themselves and the company. Each agent, and therefore the company as a whole, can earn much more because the CRM now handles most of the routine tasks agents used to do themselves:
messages.m527491b4f719: maintaining the agency's internal property database;
messages.m93df46769c4d: matching properties with clients and tenant/buyer requests with owners;
messages.ma0dcb8eaac66: recording every call, meeting and deal;
messages.m9bbf30d2d20e: At last, agents can leave routine work behind and spend time on something no software can do for them: personal communication with clients.

Your agent is rushing from one viewing to another, their phone will not stop ringing, and they urgently need to find an owner's contact details or send a client information about an apartment they asked for yesterday. The agent starts digging through WhatsApp chats and photo albums on their phone. Untangling this mess takes time, and the client is waiting... An hour later, your agent finally finds something, but the client has already called a quicker agent and moved on to a competitor.

messages.m7dc43efb61c6: How does publishing listings to specialist property portals work? Can an administrator or manager track an agent's listing activity?
messages.m13d48ab6b451: You deal directly with the platforms and pay their fees where applicable. Our CRM handles the technical side of publishing. There is usually no need to track an agent's listing activity because listings are published automatically, provided you have a paid platform account and the property details meet its requirements. Set up feeds under “Settings” → “Advertising campaigns.”
messages.me7b85fcf4167: How do I add an agent photo or change my password?
messages.mf2e6d99973bd: To change your password, click your name at the bottom of the CRM menu, then select “Personal settings” → “Security.” Only a system administrator can change an agent's profile picture: go to “Settings” → “Employees” and select the employee.
messages.m582adf003c24: Which platform can I use to build a website on my own domain with automatic database imports?
messages.m892d304b0f5e: You can build the website on any platform and use the ReCRM API to import the database automatically.
messages.m1486261d46f8: Do you build websites for real estate agencies, and how much does it cost?
messages.mff26496db1fd: Yes. Prices start at 100,000 rubles and depend on your requirements. For example, an adapted website based on the сайтагентства.рф template starts at 100,000 rubles; a bespoke website such as https://perspektiva24.com/ starts at 300,000 rubles.
messages.m095c2d0d5a9d: Does the website display the entire database, or do I need to mark specific listings?
messages.mc35cf8fea45a: A dedicated advertising campaign is created for the website. All listings sent to this campaign appear on the website.
messages.mb493f17f1c17: Do you promote the websites you build?
messages.m53328d479927: No, but we can recommend partners who specialize in this service.
messages.md0412c36e89e: Will the website only work while my CRM subscription is paid?
messages.m6048a3093c1c: The website will continue to work for six months without a paid ReCRM subscription, but without access to ReCRM you will not be able to update property details.
messages.m56c04c11f3bc: How do I create a property?
messages.mfe5a29401ac0: To create a property, request, client or deal, click the green “+” icon in the top right and follow the on-screen instructions. A property in ReCRM.Online is part of a deal and cannot exist separately. To create one, you must create a deal, specify a client, such as the property owner, and enter the minimum property details: area, price and location on the map. This is enough to create a sale or rental deal with the property inside it. You can add the remaining details later.
messages.mf529e1a9fe80: How do I delete a user?
messages.m0e4d4d4f545e: You cannot delete a user, but you can remove them from your CRM account. You must be the account administrator or have permission to manage users. 1. Go to “Settings” → “Employees.” 2. Click the user you want to remove. 3. If they have no requests, properties, comments or tasks linked to them, simply remove them from the account. 4. If they are responsible for any records, first transfer responsibility to another employee, then remove the user.
messages.m294f2e29e8af: Can agents delete their own properties and clients?
messages.mcccb073d2c0d: ReCRM.Online lets you customize each user's access permissions in your account. For each employee, you can allow or deny actions such as creating, editing or deleting deals, clients and listings. For example, you can let them view only their department's clients, edit only their own clients and delete nothing. Properties are contained within deals, so an employee who has permission to delete a deal can also delete the property inside it.
messages.m076a7a94f2b6: Can I create a property without marking it on the map?
messages.m3b02e44f15c0: No. To create a property, you must mark its location on the map.
messages.md5dc17786bc4: Can I download my database, for example as a CSV file?
messages.ma11e67e7980a: Yes. Contact RECRM technical support, or use the API to transfer all your data to another system or storage service.
messages.ma8ff748276e4: How do I see which sales pipeline stages my clients' property search requests are at?
messages.m6ba8ea2dd1af: To view requests by pipeline stage, click “Deals” in the menu, select “Buying” or “Renting” in the “Sales pipeline” drop-down, then click “Find” at the bottom of the search form.
messages.m5ba513fc83d2: Can the system automatically find potential buyers for a new property from client requests?
messages.m111bc5ee7957: Of course! A property sale deal has a “Matches” section. It shows buyers automatically matched by the system if “Automatic matching” is enabled for the deal. You can also click “Match” and select suitable buyers manually.
messages.mf83aad6099dc: Can I create a request with a reminder if the client wants to wait, for example 2 months?
messages.m7833817d8455: Assign the agent or yourself a task for this request on the required date.
messages.mc5bda3a87a39: Can I customize the property and request search fields?
messages.m5bcee225c506: Yes, we can customize the search form for each company or account.
messages.m3f029b978d28: How do I find a client by phone number?
messages.mab47a7844b1b: Go to “Clients,” enter the phone number without spaces or hyphens in the “Contact” search field, then click “Find.”
messages.m6bb0bd34a47c: When I search by phone number, do I see every agent's clients or only those previously added by the current agent?
messages.mb044c74ff419: Each user sees only the clients they are permitted to access. For example, an employee can be limited to seeing only their own clients or those of their department.
messages.m75a9c9ee60de: How can an employee receive notifications when a task is assigned to them?
messages.md8be67e6e705: ReCRM.Online users can receive notifications, including new task alerts, in two ways: 1. By email. 2. Through a Telegram bot. To set them up, click your name at the bottom of the right-hand menu, then go to “Personal settings” → “Notifications.” To enable email notifications, select the corresponding checkbox. For Telegram notifications, first subscribe to the bot by clicking one of the buttons under “Connect Telegram notifications.” Then return to the CRM and select “Receive notifications from the Telegram bot.” Under “Notification types,” select “Notify me when I am assigned responsibility for a task.”
messages.mca2df5000dec: How do I set up publishing to Avito?
messages.mf0deb4dd1b85: First, make sure you have an Avito “Store” and a paid listing package. Then go to CRM “Settings” → “Advertising campaigns,” click “Add” and select “Avito.” In the window that opens, leave “Add existing listings to the campaign” selected and create the campaign. After about half an hour, open the campaign, copy its XML feed link and add it to your Avito account. Your properties will then begin appearing on Avito after some time.
messages.mf9dc6901ecbb: How do I choose which properties to publish on which platforms?
messages.m46b2bbc2b628: Open the property sale deal, select “Listings” in the left-hand submenu, then use the “Status” column to choose the platforms to publish to.
messages.m0d09c5defd07: How does the date range affect the sales pipeline report?
messages.m7333f54efaed: The report includes only deals with activity within the selected date range: moving to a different pipeline stage, adding comments or editing deal details.
messages.m01f2c41fbab4: What do I need to enable the Avito spending report?
messages.m04c9c9509248: Ask Avito support for three values: your Avito user ID, API Client ID and API Client Secret. Enable “API integration” in your Avito advertising campaign settings, then enter all three values there.
messages.m2f3d8f31df6e: On business days, all questions are answered within one business day at most. We generally aim to respond within an hour or sooner.
messages.m8d7e0d862b28: Is the system still being developed? Are upgrades free during my paid subscription?
messages.m0d0b15a4c1d7: The product continues to improve every day, and yes, updates come at no extra charge.
messages.m93b1e86b2ce7: Can you customize or extend the product on request? Is this free or paid?
messages.md463df70bb5a: We are happy to discuss your needs, but we reserve the right to decide on any changes to ReCRM. Custom development requested by clients is a paid service, with prices starting at 50,000 rubles.
messages.m7353de836601: Will the changes I commission be available only to me or to all your clients?
messages.m5508ef13c1ed: All product features are available to all clients according to their subscription plan. We do not develop features exclusively for individual clients. The exception is custom design for property presentations, the CRM interface or a website. A custom design is available only in your version of the product.
messages.m6e5a68602bde: What if I want a change but do not want to pay?
messages.m9391b4e6e937: That is possible, but you will need to wait. We will review your request and, if it is new to us, add it to the product backlog. When other clients request the same thing, we will increase its priority. Once your request reaches the front of the queue and our tireless developers implement it, you will receive it for free. In this case, we make no commitments about timing or exactly how the change will be implemented.
